signals.title: Zillow non-engineers build production routing features with Replit
signals.summary: VentureBeat reported that non-technical Zillow employees help build software on Replit, and their features are part of the customer routing system that connects over 100,000 home shoppers with agents. Zillow was also the only customer named in Replit's July 2025 Microsoft announcement.

signals.title: Effort-based pricing for Replit Agent
signals.summary: Replit replaced its flat $0.25-per-checkpoint Agent charge with effort-based pricing, where simple changes may cost less and complex tasks bundled into one checkpoint may cost more. It also added per-request controls (a more capable model, extended thinking) to choose how much effort the Agent spends.

signals.title: Replit and Microsoft partner to bring vibe coding to enterprise (Azure)
signals.summary: Replit announced a strategic partnership with Microsoft integrating with Azure Container Apps, Azure Virtual Machines and Neon Serverless Postgres on Azure, with Azure Marketplace purchasing described as coming soon. The release states Replit is SOC 2 Type II compliant and cites over 500,000 business users.

signals.title: Replit raises $250M at $3B valuation; ~$150M annualized revenue
signals.summary: TechCrunch reported a $250M round led by Prysm Capital at a $3B valuation. The article says annualized revenue grew from $2.8M to $150M in less than a year, citing $100M ARR in June per Amjad Masad.

signals.title: Agent 3 launch
signals.summary: Replit's changelog announced Agent 3 with upgrades to autonomy, reliability and speed, including unattended runs of up to 200 minutes and App Testing in a real browser with a self-review fix loop. It also introduced Agents & Automations (beta) that run on schedules or connect to Slack and Telegram.

signals.title: Replit acquires OpenInt (first acquisition)
signals.summary: Replit announced its first acquisition, OpenInt, an integration platform for coding agents that now underpins Replit Connectors. OpenInt Cloud was set to shut down on December 31, 2025, with customers moved to self-hosted solutions.

signals.title: Jordan Ministry of Education pilots Siraj AI learning assistant built with Replit
signals.summary: The Jordanian Ministry of Education began a pilot of Siraj, an Arabic, textbook-grounded AI learning assistant built with Replit, reaching 100,000+ students and teachers and 600,000+ interactions. After the pilot the Ministry plans a nationwide rollout to 1.6M students and 90,000 teachers.

signals.title: Replit app inside ChatGPT
signals.summary: IT Brief reported Replit launched an integration letting ChatGPT users create, preview and refine apps within the chat, built by Replit Agent, alongside a revamped free tier with daily credits. Replit docs (https://docs.replit.com/getting-started/quickstarts/build-in-chatgpt) note each conversation can only work on the one app it created; date is the trade-press publication date.

signals.title: Enterprise engineering roles opened (Enterprise, Enterprise Platform, Enterprise PM)
signals.summary: Replit's Ashby job board lists still-open enterprise-focused roles first published 2026-01-24 (Software Engineer, Enterprise), 2026-02-04 and 2026-03-24 (Enterprise Platform), and 2026-06-18 (Enterprise Product Manager). Dates are Ashby publishedAt values as of 2026-10-12.

signals.title: replit/replit-gemini-extension: Replit extension for Gemini CLI
signals.summary: Replit's GitHub org hosts an MIT-licensed extension that lets users create apps and automations with Replit from the Gemini CLI via MCP authentication. Date is the repository creation date per the GitHub API; it was last pushed 2026-09-29.

signals.title: Mobile: Agent generates React Native iOS apps with Expo path to TestFlight and App Store
signals.summary: Replit's product-team post says Agent is tuned to generate React Native iOS apps from a prompt, using Expo to guide apps to TestFlight and the App Store. Planned next: shared web and mobile projects, RevenueCat in-app payments and Android publishing.

signals.title: We Built a Video Rendering Engine by Lying to the Browser About What Time It Is
signals.summary: Replit Engineering described a deterministic web-page-to-MP4 renderer built on a roughly 1,200-line injected virtual clock, WebCodecs video decoding and server-side FFmpeg audio mixing, with SSRF checks on requests. The post says Replit plans to open-source its implementation.

signals.title: $400M Series D at $9B valuation, led by Georgian
signals.summary: Replit raised a $400M Series D at a $9B valuation led by Georgian, with strategic investors including Accenture Ventures, Databricks Ventures and Okta Ventures. It reported 50M+ users, users from 85% of the Fortune 500, and a target of $1B run-rate revenue by end of 2026.

signals.title: Agent 4 launch: Design Canvas, Plan mode, parallel tasks
signals.summary: Replit's changelog announced Agent 4 as an 'AI creative partner' for apps, designs and slides, with a Design Canvas for mockups before code, Plan mode, parallel task execution and multiplayer collaboration. It also lets users pull data from BigQuery, Linear, Slack and Notion directly from chat.

signals.title: Replit named 2026 Google Cloud AI Tooling Partner of the Year
signals.summary: Replit's blog says Google Cloud named it a 2026 partner award winner, and cites 50M+ users, use across 85% of the Fortune 500, and enterprise customers Databricks, Zillow, PayPal and Adobe. It notes availability on Google Cloud Marketplace and links to Cloud Run, GKE and BigQuery.

signals.title: Replit Enterprise now self-serve (SSO, SCIM, pooled credits)
signals.summary: Any organization can buy Replit Enterprise on the website with an annual credit commitment, unlimited seats by default and pooled credits, SSO/SCIM, RBAC and audit logs, paid by card or ACH. Deals above $200K or with custom terms still go to sales.

signals.title: Visa makes undisclosed strategic investment in Replit
signals.summary: TechCrunch reported Visa invested an undisclosed amount, and the companies are exploring letting developers and their agents accept payments in Replit via Visa Intelligent Commerce and the Trusted Agent Protocol; no joint product has been announced. It says 1,000+ Visa employees have used Replit.

signals.title: Microsoft Fabric collaboration: build enterprise data apps in Replit and deploy into Fabric
signals.summary: Amjad Masad's post announced a collaboration letting enterprises build AI-powered apps in Replit and deploy them within their Microsoft Fabric tenant, enabled by Rayfin, described as an open-source SDK and CLI for app backends. Replit docs describe the integration as preview with an approved-tester requirement.

signals.title: Databricks U2M connector live; integration in public preview
signals.summary: Replit launched a user-to-machine connector for its Databricks integration so Unity Catalog applies individual user permissions to deployed Replit apps, and opened the integration for public preview sign-up.

signals.title: Agent Skills & Custom Instructions
signals.summary: Custom Instructions are persistent workspace-wide guidelines Replit Agent applies to every project, and Skills are reusable instruction files loaded only when a task matches. Together they give the agent standing knowledge of team conventions such as security rules and design systems.

signals.title: Replit is now available in Claude
signals.summary: Replit became accessible inside Claude: users can send a design from Claude Design to Replit to continue building, or have Claude delegate development tasks to Replit via an official connector.

signals.title: Inaugural Vibecon held in New York
signals.summary: Replit recap of its first Vibecon, a two-day event in an industrial space on New York's Lower East Side with speakers including Spike Jonze, Refik Anadol and Reshma Saujani. The post announces no products; date is the recap publication date.

signals.title: Closing the loop: evaluating and improving Replit Agent at scale
signals.summary: Replit described moving Agent evaluation from a pre-release gate to a continuous loop combining offline benchmarks (ViBench), production A/B tests and trace clustering (Telescope). An agent-driven process proposes and tests fixes that engineers review before release.

signals.title: The Self-Driving Company
signals.summary: Replit reported its engineers roughly tripled code output over about six months while review times, reversions and incidents held steady or improved. It attributes this to internal AI agents that investigate incidents, review code and handle business tasks.

signals.title: Introducing Replit Design
signals.summary: Replit launched Replit Design, a creative suite with AI-suggested variations, templates, a Mobbin UI reference library and brand design systems. It lets users choose among models including Claude, GPT-5, Gemini, Kimi and GLM, and launched for all users.

signals.title: Semgrep and Replit expand integration inside Security Center
signals.summary: A Business Wire release says Semgrep Guardian secrets detection now runs in Replit's Security Center for all users, and that combining Semgrep SAST with Agent LLM reasoning filters up to 93.3% of false positives. It builds on a 2025 integration using Semgrep Community Edition rules.

signals.title: Govern Replit at scale: enterprise governance tools
signals.summary: Replit announced audit logs with 50+ events and SIEM streaming, a beta Admin API, Workspace Settings for company-wide policy baselines, and a Compliance API. Audit logs and the Admin API were available at announcement; the other two were slated for later rollout.

signals.title: Black-box pen tests on Replit: white-box and black-box scans find different flaws
signals.summary: Replit added black-box penetration testing, which probes a deployed app from outside with only its link, alongside white-box code scans in a Level 3 Security Center scan. Running both on the same apps surfaced different issues with little overlap.

signals.title: Free Mode for Core and Pro subscribers
signals.summary: Free Mode, powered by OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna, lets Core and Pro subscribers run everyday Agent tasks without spending credits, with limits resetting every 5 hours. Users can switch to Power or Max Mode for complex work; Replit says Core users get about 30x previous creation capacity for $20/month.

signals.title: Intelligent Model Routing open to all users
signals.summary: Replit made Intelligent Model Routing available to all users; it automatically picks the model best suited to each job, balancing quality, speed and cost.

signals.title: Replit opens London office, its first outside the US
signals.summary: Replit opened a King's Cross office as the hub for European operations, with London Mayor Sadiq Khan at the opening, and said it expects to double headcount and investment in the coming year. It also announced a pilot four-week vibe coding course for 100 NEET young people with The Lord Mayor's Appeal.

signals.title: Databricks integration generally available with native Lakebase support
signals.summary: Replit's Databricks integration moved from June public preview to GA; Agent provisions a Lakebase database automatically, with isolated preview deploys and Unity Catalog governed migrations requiring team approval.

signals.title: Replit acquires Atta (business analysis & charting)
signals.summary: Replit acquired San Francisco-based Atta, a business analysis and charting company. Atta's interactive charts are integrated into Replit chat so users can ask Agent to visualize data without writing SQL.

signals.title: Free the models: Harness design at the frontier
signals.summary: Replit argues agent harnesses should let strong models decide when to delegate and how hard to think rather than prescribe workflows. It reports Replit Agent (on GPT-6 Astra) beat a single long-lived 'sidekick' worker setup by 11 and 16 points on DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench.

signals.title: replit/dev-modules: OIDC modules for AWS, GCP, Azure, Vault and Infisical
signals.summary: MIT-licensed repository of prebuilt modules that configure cloud CLIs and SDKs with short-lived credentials via Replit as an OpenID Connect identity provider (workload identity federation). Date is the repository creation date per the GitHub API.

signals.title: Open roles snapshot: 69 postings; payments/commerce, international GTM, security
signals.summary: Replit's Ashby board listed 69 open roles on 2026-10-12, led by Product Engineering (13), Support Delivery (8), Platform (6), SRE (6) and Sales (5). Titles include Agentic Commerce & Payments, Agentic Ads, Money Infrastructure, AI Agent Security Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Head of Corporate Development, and Japan/Tokyo/Singapore/London roles.

signals.title: Leadership page lists President, CTO, CRO and Chief People Officer
signals.summary: Replit's About page (viewed 2026-10-12) lists Amjad Masad (Founder & CEO), Haya Odeh (Co-Founder, VP Design), Michele Catasta (President), Luis Hector Chavez (CTO), Ghazi Masood (CRO), Stacey La Torre (Chief People Officer), Scott Kennedy (VP Engineering), Jordan Walke (Head of Product) and Robert Kohse (General Counsel). No hire dates are given on the page.

signals.title: Hiring mix: 69 open roles, 54 in Foster City; GTM and User Operations 22; London, Japan, Singapore
signals.summary: Per Ashby's public job-board API on 2026-10-12, 69 roles span Engineering (38), GTM (11), User Operations (11), G&A (6), Brand & Creative (2) and Design (1). Locations: Foster City 54, NYC 6, Japan remote 3, London 2, Singapore 1, other US 3.

timeMachine.announcement: Agent 4 launch with parallel tasks and in-chat integrations (BigQuery, Linear, Slack, Notion)
timeMachine.why: Agent 3 (2025-09-12) already pushed long-running autonomous work and agents connected to Slack/Telegram, and the OpenInt acquisition (2025-09-30) gave Replit an integration platform as the base of Replit Connectors, pointing toward an agent that runs more work at once and pulls in third-party data from chat.

timeMachine.announcement: Enterprise governance tools: audit logs, Admin API, Workspace Settings, Compliance API
timeMachine.why: Enterprise and Enterprise Platform engineering roles opened from January 2026, the March Series D brought in Okta, Databricks and Accenture as strategic investors and cited Fortune 500 usage, and June shipped Databricks per-user permissions and workspace-wide Custom Instructions, all ahead of company-wide admin and compliance controls.
